title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who confronts Niv-Mizzet about the Omenpath Project and offers him his services.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Proft's assistant, a former assassin who tries to keep him from antagonizing the dragon.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon Firemind and Living Guildpact of Ravnica, who is secretly running the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: A careful man and Proft's former ally who worked on a project for Niv-Mizzet and died for it.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya leader who used the substance of Ravnica itself to kill people she deemed enemies of the city.

entities.name: Chamberlain Maree
entities.description: The Izzet chamberlain who might have been delighted by Zarek's death for what it would mean for her position.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: The Izzet guild leader whom a murderer planned to have assassinated.

entities.name: Omenpath Project
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's secret project, run through agents in all guilds, to map and control the Omenpaths and make Ravnica the hub of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Rifts in the fabric of the plane that opened after the invasion, a phenomenon natural to Kaldheim, giving ways on and off Ravnica.

entities.name: Kylox's cryptex
entities.description: A cryptex recovered by Proft from Kylox's lab, which Proft decoded to learn of the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane that Niv-Mizzet wants to make the center of the connected Multiverse.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane where Omenpaths are a natural phenomenon.

events.summary: Proft and Etrata enter Niv-Mizzet's chamber for an appointment that was hard to obtain.
events.quote: Proft's footsteps echoed as he walked into the chamber currently occupied by Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind and Living Guildpact.

events.summary: Proft asks how Niv-Mizzet could fail to notice Trostani's use of Ravnica to kill, and the dragon says he was otherwise occupied.
events.quote: "I was otherwise occupied," said Niv-Mizzet, somewhat stiffly.

events.summary: Proft raises Kylox's project, and reasons that Niv-Mizzet stood back because he was working on something larger than a few murders.
events.quote: the only reason you would stand back was because you were working on something bigger.

events.summary: Proft reveals he decoded Kylox's cryptex and knows about the Omenpath Project.
events.quote: I know about the Omenpath Project.

events.summary: Proft explains that rifts called Omenpaths opened across the planes after the invasion, and Niv-Mizzet says they are natural to Kaldheim.
events.quote: A phenomenon natural to the plane of Kaldheim.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet explains the Omenpaths are his responsibility as Living Guildpact, as they could be used to exploit security gaps or smuggle goods.
events.quote: As Living Guildpact, they're my responsibility.

events.summary: Proft deduces that Niv-Mizzet plans to make Ravnica the hub of the connected Multiverse, and Niv-Mizzet confirms it.
Proft offers his and Etrata's services to Niv-Mizzet, who is surprised and admits the deductive skills would be welcome.
events.quote: Your deductive skills would not be unwelcome,

relations.note: Niv-Mizzet directs agents across all guilds on the project.
relations.quote: You have agents across all the guilds, hard at work on different aspects of the same project.

relations.note: Kylox worked on Niv-Mizzet's project and died for it.
relations.quote: But he was working for you, and he died

relations.note: Etrata is supposed to keep Proft from dying.
relations.quote: Remember how I'm supposed to keep you from dying?

relations.note: Proft calls Kylox an ally and a friend of sorts.
relations.quote: He was an ally. A friend, of sorts.
